_comment: F1's AUTHORED ANSWER (hand-written before any builder exists). Identities per A2: (source, schema, table[, column]). Apply order: simemr then org.

db.name: SIMDB
db._witness: A1 REFINED: db exists BEFORE any intake, declared by the DBA, never extract-derived; both extracts attach downward; INTAKE-9: captured DB_NAME() agrees with the prereq

schemas._witness: source = the identity's first component, from the registration's schema mapping — never a second stored field

tables._witness: phrase rule yields grain only (business_name CUT 2026-09-05 — derivable from the stored description at read time)
tables.description: The patient table contains one record for each patient in your system. The primary key for the patient table is PATIENT_ID.
The encounter table contains one record for each patient encounter in your system. The primary key for the encounter table is ENCOUNTER_ID.

tables._witness: pk from DECLARED pk data (Sunny's CLARITY_TBL_PK-style ruling) = the surrogate; the composite (ENCOUNTER_ID, LINE) remains an inbound REFERENCED key — pk_columns and referenced_keys provably differ. Surrogate pks are also why grain-from-pk is unreliable; grain stays phrase-derived, opportunistic.
tables.description: The encounter diagnosis table contains one record for each diagnosis on an encounter in your system. The primary key for the encounter diagnosis table is ENCOUNTER_DX_ID.

columns._expectation: EVERY column from both snapshots' columns.csv exists as a column node with its description VERBATIM and its as_of — 19 simemr + 2 org. Enumerated here by rule rather than repetition; the conformance check compares against the csv directly (single source, no drift).

simemr|dbo|ENCOUNTER|APPT_STATUS_C._witness: values via DECLARED join to a value table, keys as trimmed strings

layer3_expected._witness: organizational ownership minted from the prereq (the earlier dba option-B ruling, now with its mechanism)

referenced_keys_expected._witness: the referenced-keys LENS (derived from inbound joins_to; never stored): total over referenced tables; leaves (DX_COMMENT, STAGING_LOG, ORG_READMIT) honestly absent. ENCOUNTER now has TWO inbound groups (ORG_READMIT and ENCOUNTER_DX) referencing ONE column-set -> one distinct key: the lens yields distinct sets, not one row per FK

joins_to._witness: fk_num groups the composite; ordinal orders pairs
fk_num 3+4 DEDUPED to one edge (double-declared value link, category column wins)
INTAKE-6 legal: declarer (org) owns the dependent side; cross-source join
Sunny's fixture catch: the documented parent relationship, now declared

gap_lists._pk_note: empty BY STRUCTURE: INTAKE-10 refuses extracts with keyless tables (Sunny's integrity ruling)
gap_lists._grain_note: grain is the phrase rules' sole surviving yield (pk = declared data; business_name cut); these four descriptions lack the grain boilerplate — absent + counted, ruled acceptable

org.change_report: org_custom chain + 1 table created; db node NOT re-created (A1)

intake_expectations._registration: both snapshots name the registered db -> INTAKE-8 pass; an unregistered db would be a named refusal

rebuild_expectation: applying both snapshots twice in the same order yields a deep-equal graph (LC-S3 idempotence, CHECK-TL-3)
